purpose: Machine-readable catalog of AutostopManager memory and routing MCP tools used by the manager agent.
crm_gateway_role: Mounted into the CRM raw registry; production publishes only the selected Gateway v2 workflow tools, never this whole catalog.
memory_is_source_of_truth_for: routing rules distilled from approved source files

tool_contracts.remember: Store long-term manager memory that does not belong in AutoStop CRM cards; prefer distilled conclusions over raw source copies; facts may carry confidence.
tool_contracts.recall: Search memory with relevance scoring and optional kind/category/tag filters before assuming owner context, style preferences, operating lessons, or durable rules are unknown.
tool_contracts.learn_from_feedback: Store a concise reusable lesson after strong owner feedback, praise, criticism, clear success, or clear failure; store the lesson, not raw CRM/Gmail/event copies.
tool_contracts.recall_lessons: Search reusable manager lessons by query, applies_to, signal, and tags before similar work.
tool_contracts.memory_map: Return compact counts and sections for manager memory so the agent can navigate memory before broad recall.
tool_contracts.memory_topics: Return memory categories and tags with counts and examples for navigation and review.
tool_contracts.memory_context_for: Build compact memory context for a task: relevant preferences, rules, lessons, source boundaries, and suggested use; treat as context, not a template.
tool_contracts.memory_gaps: Return sparse or empty memory areas and review prompts without copying CRM or Gmail data.
tool_contracts.add_manager_task: Create a durable task that is not a CRM card or repair order.
tool_contracts.today_context: Return open tasks, due reminders, recent journal entries, and the current rule set.
tool_contracts.prepare_manager_context: Combine owner command routes, relevant memory/rules, knowledge routing, missing required context, and next actions for a specific request.
tool_contracts.agent_brief: Return the mandatory compact startup package for an agent before broad document reads or CRM work: role, route, memory_sources, source boundaries, hot rules, read order, allowed/forbidden actions, missing context, context_safety, next actions, and verification.
tool_contracts.agent_bootstrap: Return AgentEnvelopeV2 with the deterministic selected workflow, source boundaries, safety policy, missing context, and resumable unfinished runs without reading or writing live CRM/Gmail.
tool_contracts.agent_mode: Read, set, or resolve the durable work/learning execution mode. Work is fast ordinary verification; learning requires a privacy-safe post-run review. Per-turn overrides never persist prompt text.
tool_contracts.post_run_review: Close one learning turn with compact completion codes, tool-health assessment, and safe technical metadata. It rejects prompts, raw CRM/Store/Gmail payloads, VINs, contacts, and financial values; an optional candidate keeps the cycle open until promoted, deferred, or rolled back.
tool_contracts.agent_learning_workflow: Advance a reviewed improvement candidate through repair, verify, promote, defer, rollback, or summary. It records lifecycle evidence only; actual code/docs/deploy changes remain governed by the active task, test, and readback rules.
tool_contracts.agent_case_resolver: READ_ONLY RAW_CAPABILITY. Build a connector-neutral source-read DAG or reconcile compact scalar evidence for one opaque case. It never calls connectors or writes CRM, Store, Gmail, memory, workflow state, or files; raw prompt/payload/identifier fields are rejected and resolved values are display-redacted.
tool_contracts.list_agent_workflows: List the compact named Agent Gateway v2 workflow registry and resolve a query or explicit intent deterministically.
tool_contracts.store_runtime_status: INTERNAL_ONLY. Return store_agent_v1 adapter configuration booleans, circuit state, optional live AutoStop App health, or the one-request stateless bootstrap snapshot without exposing token values. The snapshot never reads or advances digest checkpoints. Gateway raw discovery must exclude it and map health through existing bootstrap/runtime tools.
tool_contracts.store_digest: INTERNAL_ONLY. Read one bounded pure-read store digest page with at-least-once delivery. Uses isolated store_digest/store_bootstrap streams, persists only technical cursor/timestamp/success state/compact refs, returns a Manager-owned cursor-bound ACK for every non-empty page, replays unacknowledged pages from the fixed App window, and commits high-water only after final ACK. Gateway raw discovery must exclude it.
tool_contracts.store_search: INTERNAL_ONLY. Search one allowlisted store entity through the pure-read AutoStop App agent API with compact store_agent_v1 DTOs, bounded limit, opaque pagination, schema validation, and contact redaction. Gateway maps it through agent_search.
tool_contracts.store_entity_context: INTERNAL_ONLY. Read one exact allowlisted store entity with summary, full, or full_with_vin_photo detail. General reads remain redacted; exact full quote reads use the dedicated quote credential and may transiently return contacts, VIN, items, offers, notes, drafts, and bounded VIN-photo metadata. Gateway maps it through agent_entity_context and never persists the payload.
tool_contracts.download_store_quote_vin_photo: INTERNAL_ONLY. Read one exact quote VIN-photo JPEG preview through the dedicated quote credential and expected photo SHA-256. Bytes are transient only; Gateway maps it through agent_document_workflow with explicit allow_large_output and never exposes it through raw discovery.
tool_contracts.store_management_action: INTERNAL_ONLY. Execute only assign_quote_request, set_quote_request_status, update_quote_request_comment, add_quote_request_note, replace_quote_offer_drafts, set_batch_storage_location, or mark_order_ready after ActionContractV2, exact preread, expected_updated_at, idempotency, correlation, dry_run/apply, and exact readback. Quote drafts remain private. Gateway raw discovery excludes it and agent_inventory_workflow enforces policy.
tool_contracts.store_owner_capabilities: READ_ONLY RAW_CAPABILITY. Discover the current typed employee API inventory from live Store OpenAPI through the dedicated owner principal; excludes public/customer and human login/logout routes and returns no business data.
tool_contracts.store_owner_api: OWNER_SCOPED RAW_CAPABILITY. Read or execute one typed employee API operation through the same AutoStop App route used by Flutter. Writes require ActionContractV2 metadata, exact target/revision, idempotency, correlation and a matching schema-bound dry-run proof; applied results stay compensating until exact reread. Responses remain transient.
tool_contracts.prepare_action_contract: Build ActionContractV2 for CRM, store, finance, inventory, documents, files, or Gmail writes with task intent, exact target, idempotency, concurrency, automatic preflight, compensation, and readback verification; store dry-run/apply phase keys remain distinct while their validated or derived correlation stays stable; never performs the write.
tool_contracts.prepare_crm_card_action: Build a dry-run CRM card edit contract with exact description patch, vehicle_profile metadata preservation, board_summary target, expected_updated_at, tool sequence, ledger schema, risk flags, and strict reread verification; never writes CRM.
tool_contracts.manager_journal: Append a bounded generic event or operate the unified director journal through director_create, director_read, director_update, director_stats, and director_prune; director entries may keep context-bearing active waits, actor roles, planned events, next reviews and safe hash-links, remain concurrency-protected, never copy CRM records, correspondence, private identifiers or money data, are capped at 400 total and 50 active records, and retain terminal records for at most 180 days.
tool_contracts.sync_knowledge_base: Refresh the SQLite index of docs/agent/knowledge_map.json routes, playbooks, source catalogs, and model-specific skills.
tool_contracts.probe_knowledge_base: Cheaply test whether local knowledge exists for a vehicle, model, system, brand, fluid, diagnostic, parts, CRM, or source-intake task; if has_knowledge=true, open open_first/source_of_truth first; for routes with optional_runtime_files, report available/missing runtime files before claiming exact private facts.
tool_contracts.search_knowledge_base: Search indexed knowledge sections after probing; optionally filter by domain such as fluids, automotive_repair, bmw_repair, bmw_f15_n63, toyota_gr_yaris, or vehicle_identity_and_oem.
tool_contracts.audit_knowledge_base: Check knowledge_map.json, route-card metadata, mapped files, SQLite index counts, and FTS health after source intake or route edits.
tool_contracts.audit_knowledge_annotations: Check docs/agent/knowledge_annotations.jsonl compact file-level annotations and their domain coverage.
tool_contracts.audit_skill_registry: Check local Codex skill files linked from knowledge_map.json and report missing or unlinked skills.
tool_contracts.system_audit: Run the canonical read-only AutoStop Manager health layer: knowledge audit, annotations audit, skills audit, cleanup dry-run summary, local SQLite stats, MCP catalog consistency, and tests_status=external.
tool_contracts.cleanup_audit: Run the dry-run cleanup audit for caches, duplicate PDFs, unreferenced agent docs, untracked generated root artifacts, retained local DB size, overindexed source packs, and compact project-footprint metadata; never deletes or moves files.
tool_contracts.crm_health_plan: Build a read-only CRM health plan from already fetched board_context, board_review, and today_context payloads; never calls live CRM write tools and reports cards_moved=0 and cards_archived=0.
tool_contracts.audit_memory: Check long-term manager memory for duplicate, expired, and superseded note/fact records before cleanup without returning raw content previews.
tool_contracts.curate_memory: Non-destructively curate manager memory; with apply=true, archive duplicate note/fact copies instead of deleting source records.
tool_contracts.start_workflow: Start an idempotent v2 workflow in planned state with request/correlation IDs, compact scope, selected IDs, and no external mutation.
tool_contracts.workflow_status: Read one workflow state, checkpoint, events, and refs-only external steps in AgentEnvelopeV2.
tool_contracts.workflow_transition: Advance a workflow through the strict planned/executing/external_wait/verifying/compensating/terminal state machine. Pass expected_state_version from the latest response for compare-and-swap; completed requires non-empty evidence and rejects explicit executor/readback/verification failure markers.
tool_contracts.workflow_checkpoint: Persist a compact resume point and selected IDs; rejects raw email bodies and oversized checkpoints. Pass expected_state_version from the latest workflow response for compare-and-swap.
tool_contracts.workflow_wait_for_external: Register a refs-only step for a separate connector such as Gmail or Telegram and enter external_wait. Pass expected_state_version from the latest workflow response for compare-and-swap.
tool_contracts.complete_external_step: Complete an external step idempotently using message/thread/draft/attachment/file IDs and timestamps only; raw Gmail bodies and Telegram text are rejected. Pass expected_state_version from the latest workflow response for compare-and-swap.
tool_contracts.workflow_resume: Resume from a compact checkpoint after all required external steps complete. Pass expected_state_version from workflow_status for compare-and-swap.
tool_contracts.workflow_cancel: Cancel a non-terminal workflow without changing CRM, Gmail, or Telegram state. Pass expected_state_version from workflow_status for compare-and-swap.
tool_contracts.lookup_original_parts: Classify VIN, chassis, or market code and return a source-aware OEM lookup route.
tool_contracts.decode_vehicle_identity: Build a source-aware vehicle identity dossier from VIN/frame/body number: identifier classification, check digit/model-year diagnostics, vPIC/WMI/platform evidence, CRM-context conflicts, confidence label, adapter status, and required EPC/API sources before VIN-critical parts lookup; live_vpic and live_wmi can be disabled independently for local-only identity checks.
tool_contracts.decode_vehicle_identities: Batch vehicle identity dossiers for VIN/frame/body-number lists without durable raw VIN persistence; uses public vPIC batch when enabled and reports batch coverage for CRM board scans.
tool_contracts.catalog_provider_status: Report configured VIN/OEM/cross/procurement provider readiness by stage without exposing secret values; use before claiming live catalog or supplier API access.
tool_contracts.plan_oem_parts_providers: Build provider readiness and blocker plan for VIN/frame -> OEM candidates -> crosses/applicability -> procurement/RF market price. It redacts identifiers and does not call suppliers or write CRM.
tool_contracts.vin17_decode_vehicle: Call or dry-run the configured 17VIN API vehicle decoder using VIN17_ACCOUNT/VIN17_SECRET; expose only redacted request evidence and never expose token/secret.
tool_contracts.vin17_search_part_number_by_vin: Call or dry-run 17VIN search_part_number by VIN after a 17VIN decode returns an EPC code; use for read-only fitment checks, not supplier orders.
tool_contracts.partsapi_catalog_lookup: Call or dry-run PartsAPI VIN/registration-number/OE/applicability/cross/part-name/engine/category/article/AUTONORMS lookup using PARTSAPI_BASE_URL plus PARTSAPI_KEY or a method-specific PARTSAPI_*_KEY; supports VINdecode, VINdecodeOE, gosnomer2vin, getPartsbyVIN, getOEApplicability, getCrosses, getCrossesWithBrand, getCrossesTitle, getPartnameByBrandNumber, getArticleCrosses, searchArticles, getEngine, getSearchTree, getArticles, getArticle, getArticleCriteria, GetNormsMakes, GetNormsModels, GetNormsMotors, GetNormsTimes, and GetFillVolumes without exposing key values. Treat a plate-derived VIN as an identity lead and verify it before CRM writes. AUTONORMS returns work-time and fluid-volume evidence, not a final workshop selling price or an oil approval. For getPartsbyVIN, part_type defaults to oem; use omit/non-oem to skip the type query parameter; timeout and max_attempts are configurable for slow live reads.
tool_contracts.search_partsapi_category_index: Search the local PartsAPI numeric category index by query/intent without live calls or secrets.
tool_contracts.explain_partsapi_category_for_intent: Explain why a local PartsAPI numeric category was selected for a part intent.
tool_contracts.validate_partsapi_category_index: Validate the tracked local PartsAPI category index fixture without exposing secrets or identifiers.
tool_contracts.public_aftermarket_catalog_lookup: Call public MANN-FILTER and DENSO Aftermarket catalogs by part/OE number; use for brand-scope catalog enrichment, not as VIN-specific OEM EPC proof or supplier price confirmation.
tool_contracts.exist_price_lookup: Call or dry-run public read-only Exist article lookup for catalog disambiguation, analog visibility, retail price benchmark, and lead time with Krasnoyarsk office 905 by default; returns public_retail_reference only and never supplier-order data.
tool_contracts.lookup_oem_catalog_candidates: Call or dry-run the multi-provider OEM candidate lookup for one VIN/frame and requested part, combining Parts-Catalogs, PartsAPI, and 17VIN when credentials and routing ids are available; accepts a custom PartsAPI category index path for reviewed local fixtures; no CRM writes or supplier orders are created.
tool_contracts.resolve_vin_oem_parts: Resolve one VIN/frame/body-number and requested part into a read-only VinOemResolution: identity, part intent, PartsAPI category, OEM candidates, enrichment, readiness gates, manual actions, and CRM gate.
tool_contracts.benchmark_vin_parts_lookup: Read-only batch benchmark for CRM VIN/frame/body-number items: identity confidence, part-intent recognition, safe public search templates, provider blockers, PartsAPI/17VIN/OEM-catalog dry-run readiness, configurable PartsAPI timeout, and opt-in live PartsAPI OE identity/OEM checks with raw identifiers redacted from output.
tool_contracts.build_vin_parts_work_order: Build read-only per-card VIN/frame parts lookup work orders: exact OEM/EPC routes, prepared API checks, cross/applicability steps, supplier routes, read-only candidate lookup vs CRM writeback gates, blockers, and acceptance checklists with raw identifiers redacted from output.
tool_contracts.recommend_automotive_sources: Select authoritative repair or technical source routes by brand and data type.
tool_contracts.recommend_fluid_maintenance_sources: Select source routes for oils, fluids, capacities, and ТО planning.
tool_contracts.lookup_public_automotive_evidence: Read compact official public evidence: NHTSA model-level recalls, optional manufacturer-communications/TSB metadata, and Mercedes/ZF fluid-reference routes. It redacts identifiers, performs no writes, and does not treat public evidence as VIN-specific repair documentation.
tool_contracts.recommend_service_management_actions: Build a Krasnoyarsk workshop-management action plan for parts procurement, repair triage, staff load, customer flow, finance control, daily CRM control, or knowledge intake.
tool_contracts.plan_crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup: Build a deterministic CRM VIN/frame/body-number parts lookup workflow: live card intake, vehicle identification, OEM/replacement/cross lookup, internal procurement/RF market quote matrix, selected-part material line policy, compact public CRM writeback steps, and reread verification. This planner does not write CRM or place supplier orders.
tool_contracts.estimate_repair_work_cost: Build a read-only adaptive labor estimate from exact vehicle/work scope, aggregate AutoStop closed-order experience, current public Russia STO quotes, and norm-hours/labor-time evidence. Returns an EvidenceBundle, recommended price/range, source-family count, confidence, conflicts, missing context, and next actions. Internal history is an anchor only; high confidence requires exact scope plus at least three independent evidence families. No repair-order writes.
tool_contracts.control_report: Generate ControlReportV1 with server/runtime/Codex readiness, system health, git state, tests/doctor route, memory/knowledge/MCP/provider readiness, production ops gates, ports, risks, and last run ledger; read-only and secrets-redacted.
tool_contracts.memory_review: Generate rule-based MemoryReviewItem proposals for duplicates, expired/superseded items, weak confidence, and run-ledger lesson candidates without copying raw CRM, email, or secret content.
tool_contracts.memory_review_apply: Apply a pending MemoryReviewItem decision: accept, reject, or archive_duplicate. Duplicate archival revalidates active duplicate refs, is non-destructive, and never deletes source memory records.
tool_contracts.knowledge_intake_plan: Classify a source file into KnowledgeIntakeDraft with domain, source type, safety flags, target metadata updates, and required follow-up audits; apply mode is review-gated and does not commit raw private files.
tool_contracts.provider_smoke_report: Generate ProviderSmokeResult readiness checks for one provider or all providers in dry-run or live-readonly mode without order, basket, supplier write, or CRM writeback endpoints.
tool_contracts.get_store_analytics_report: Hidden read-only raw capability for one bounded aggregate-only first-party storefront report in Asia/Krasnoyarsk; uses the internal AutoStop App Store Agent URL and never returns raw events, visitor/session identifiers, exact search text, or customer data.

store_runtime_status.bootstrap_snapshot: bool=false; when true performs one stateless Store bootstrap GET and ignores digest checkpoints

store_digest.ack_token: string|null=null; if supplied, requires the matching Manager cursor

filters_by_entity.store_quote_request: status: NEW|IN_PROGRESS|PRICED|APPROVED|CONVERTED|CANCELLED; assigned_user_id: non-empty string up to 36|null
filters_by_entity.store_batch: status: IN_PROGRESS|COMPLETED; storage_location: non-empty string up to 200
filters_by_entity.store_sourcing_offer: no filters or cursor; query length at least 2

store_entity_context.detail: summary|full|full_with_vin_photo, default summary; general reads are redacted, while exact full quote reads use the dedicated quote credential and stay transient

store_management_action.action: one of seven optimized named operations
store_management_action.correlation_id: alphanumeric-first 8..160 safe identifier from ActionContractV2, stable across dry_run/apply; explicit override is optional when building the contract

planned_changes_by_action.assign_quote_request: store_quote_request; assignee_id: non-empty string up to 36
planned_changes_by_action.add_quote_request_note: store_quote_request; text: non-empty string up to 2000
planned_changes_by_action.replace_quote_offer_drafts: store_quote_request; complete Manager-owned draft post-state for one exact quote: 1..20 exact items, 0..3 strict private drafts per item; omitted prior drafts are superseded
planned_changes_by_action.set_batch_storage_location: store_batch; storage_location: non-empty string up to 200
planned_changes_by_action.mark_order_ready: store_order; status: READY from IN_PROGRESS only

store_owner_capabilities.limit: integer=200, clamped 1..250 so one call can inventory every current employee operation
store_owner_capabilities.source: live AutoStop App OpenAPI filtered to employee routes; no business data

store_owner_api.risk: live read|write|high_risk_write classification; high-risk and existing-target writes require current revision
store_owner_api.schema_hash: exact SHA-256 operation schema hash returned by live capability discovery and bound into dry-run proof
store_owner_api.mode: read for GET; dry_run|apply for writes
store_owner_api.target_id: exact entity or reviewed collection ref for writes
store_owner_api.body: bounded JSON request body, transient only
store_owner_api.files: bounded transient base64 files with field, filename, content_type and content_base64
store_owner_api.dry_run_proof: required matching schema-bound plan hash for every apply
store_owner_api.allow_binary_response: false by default; true only for an explicit bounded document request

Director mode.authority: The active owner director goal delegates autonomous CRM reads, highest-value priority selection for profit, throughput, commitments and risk, verified non-financial exact-target writes, and bounded factual Telegram questions to allowlisted internal roles. It restores all active unified journal decisions and future-dated waits, reconciles them with live CRM before asking new questions, and keeps context-bearing operational meaning plus safe hash-links without copied CRM records or private identifiers.
forbidden_actions: payments, cashbox, refunds, payroll or financial-total changes without separate exact authority
supplier orders, Store work, client promises or outreach outside allowlisted internal roles
raw CRM snapshots, Telegram text, contact tables or private identifiers in Manager memory

aliases: какая конверсия в корзину и заказ
Store analytics.authority: aggregate-only first-party storefront statistics from the protected internal AutoStop App report endpoint
forbidden_data: exact search queries, form values, customer contacts, or VIN

Learning mode.authority: The active owner task authorizes non-financial exact-target work after contracts and readback. Learning data is technical and hash-only; financial changes and external repairs remain outside automatic learning.

Приберись.authority: card-focused cleanup governed by docs/agent/board_cleanup_autopilot_playbook.md, with strict preservation of repair-order, payment, cashbox, and user-entered CRM evidence
Приберись.multi_card_behavior: When the owner asks to run Приберись for many or all active cards, apply the same one-card cleanup locally to each card that actually needs it; process small verified batches and leave already-clear cards unchanged.
allowed_actions: update confirmed card title, compact vehicle, public description, and no more than three operational tags
enrich source-backed vehicle profiles including VIN, plate, mileage, engine, gearbox, and drivetrain when evidence is adequate
move phone/VIN/plate/mileage/aggregate facts into structured fields, link or update the clear matching client by phone first, and upsert confirmed client vehicle facts
source VIN/OEM/parts/maintenance data for direct safe tasks written in the card
create or update description and board_summary according to the single canonical docs/agent/crm_card_description_standard.md without duplicating its composition, length or formatting rules
leave archive recommendations when a card looks completed
forbidden_actions: move cards between columns unless the owner gives a separate explicit owner command
archive cards unless the owner gives a separate explicit owner command
edit repair orders, works, materials, prices, payments, cashboxes, or cash records unless the owner explicitly asks for that exact target
delete or merge client records during routine cleanup
change card deadlines or indicators unless the owner asks for timer/signal work for the exact target
invent unsupported filler or assumptions when creating or updating a public description
add risks, safety caveats, source/provenance, selection method, search history, supplier-check reminders, or quote-matrix reports to public descriptions
keep transferred phone, VIN, license plate, mileage, engine, gearbox, or drivetrain in the public description by default
put phone, VIN, full client identity, raw scan dumps, or long issue lists into board_summary

workflow: use probe_knowledge_base before broad file reads
update shelf/map routes when adding durable knowledge
update compact annotations when a file should be found by fast routing
run sync_knowledge_base after durable docs/catalog/skill changes
run audit_knowledge_base after route-card or source changes
inspect docs/agent/crm_manager_data_playbook.md before summarizing client, cashbox, repair-order, or CRM-statistics data
keep raw CRM data in live CRM or local private runtime files unless the owner explicitly approves an exact private export
do_not_store: raw store orders, customer contacts, line items, stock rows, warehouse dumps, or API payloads

command_routes.rule: Natural owner command aliases must map to an intent, domain, open_first file, memory queries, and next actions before broad knowledge search.

run_ledger.source_of_truth: SQLite manager_runs, manager_run_events, and manager_run_external_steps tables
run_ledger.compatibility: Historical v1 rows with status running remain readable and migratable in storage, but the retired start/record/finish/list tools and CLI commands are not exposed. All new work uses Gateway v2.
use_when: multi-step store or CRM plus store work

memory_guidance: in director mode read at most 10 active structured director-journal entries after today_context and use live CRM as the source of truth
write director-journal entries only for durable de-identified decisions, recurring blockers, verified outcomes, or scheduled reviews; never for every CRM or Telegram event
keep only durable conclusions from new files
use memory_context_for before context-sensitive CRM, Gmail, writing-style, owner-preference, or repeated workflow decisions
recall owner preferences, style rules, and operating lessons before context-sensitive CRM or email work
use learn_from_feedback after strong praise, criticism, success, failure, or owner instruction to do something differently
resolve agent_mode at startup; in learning mode close post_run_review before the final response and use agent_learning_workflow only for verified lifecycle transitions
use agent_case_resolver for a read-only multi-source claim plan or evidence conflict reconciliation; execute the selected reads through their owning systems
store lessons as short reusable guidance, not full event copies or rigid output templates
store source routes, not copied databases
use importance, confidence, expires_at, supersedes_id, sensitivity, and tags when storing durable memory
run audit_memory when recall quality looks weak or before memory cleanup
use curate_memory apply=true only for non-destructive duplicate archiving
refresh the relevant catalog when the MCP surface changes
treat the owner's Приберись command as docs/agent/board_cleanup_autopilot_playbook.md
phone ChatGPT access uses the same CRM MCP endpoint when AutostopManager is mounted on the server
route management, procurement, staff, customer, and finance work through docs/agent/krasnoyarsk_service_management_playbook.md
route private ИП/AutoStop business identity and requisites through docs/agent/business_identity_playbook.md and data/private_knowledge
prefer explicit uncertainty over invented completeness
route CRM VIN/frame/body-number parts lookup through docs/agent/crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_playbook.md
use decode_vehicle_identity before OEM/parts lookup when CRM vehicle identity is incomplete, ROW/JDM, or confidence is unclear
use benchmark_vin_parts_lookup for 10-card or batch VIN/frame quality checks before claiming lookup coverage improved
use build_vin_parts_work_order after benchmark when the next step is actionable OEM/cross/supplier search by card
use catalog_provider_status and plan_oem_parts_providers before claiming that live VIN/OEM/supplier APIs are available
do not store raw customer VIN/frame values or supplier quote dumps from parts lookup in durable memory
